description: VR rest-space reconciliation (2026-10-25): every outdoor rest-space sighting (#1-17 of the VR station survey) and every garden/plaza landscape item seen in the SCNU 360 VR exterior scenes, cast as a ray from the VR station (face bearing + column angle, 10-120 m; nadir sightings as a strip under the station) against the photo survey objects-campus.geojson (8 m rule). decision: match (an object of a kind that stands for it exists), retype (an object exists under a kind the VR corrects), missing (none within 8 m; instanceId is the id stages will create), not_rest_space (a re-read of the VR shows the sighting is not a rest space or only a planting; nothing is placed), deferred (the VR station could not be registered on the photo; nothing is placed yet). applied records what todo 25 did; vr_confirmed names the existing object the VR confirms. typeId names data/rest-space-catalogue.json. photo_blob: whether the NGII 2025 photo shows a roof, wall or planter at the ray. landscape lists steps, sculptures and other items that no catalogue type models (kept for reference, same rule). Stations from scripts/perf/vr-stations.json (refined yaw where present). Applied by a later stage; this file changes no geometry.
sources: SCNU 360 VR tour exterior scenes (visual reference only, nothing copied)
